title: Buck Clayton on 52nd Street
summary: He remembers Clayton sitting in on 52nd Street.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So around that time in the mid-forties when you did the Metronome All-stars date you recorded with other well known musicians, one was with Buck Clayton. Do you have anything to say about him?
--- I used to know him. Used to come in to sit down and jam on 52nd Street when he was in town...
